slug: 2026-06-09 Meta backs NDPC in landmark privacy initiative

facts.fact: ITWeb Africa reports the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 established a comprehensive legal framework for personal data protection and empowers the NDPC to investigate breaches and enforce compliance; no date of the stated thing is given, so the article's published date is used.

The NDPC and Meta launched the two-year M-SIDP data protection programme (governance and research, platform safety, training of Data Protection Officers, public awareness), reported 9 June 2026; the launch date is not given, so the published date is used.

ITWeb Africa reports the NDPC, headed by National Commissioner and CEO Dr Vincent Olatunji, is acting under the Act, launching a programme with Meta; no event date given, so the published date is used.

ITWeb Africa reports a court-approved settlement reached in 2025 between the NDPC and Meta after regulatory proceedings over handling of Nigerian users' data, under which Meta funds a two-year programme (M-SIDP); the month is not given.
